title: WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.18067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling interactive environments is important for training long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning. These environments often require further testing and refinement after initial generation, and correcting defects in a task may also require updating its work context and verifier. However, existing construction pipelines offer limited support for such iterative refinement while keeping these components aligned. We introduce WorkRover, a framework for training long-horizon cowork agents through recursive environment evolution. Its harness-driven synthesis enables construction agents to jointly build and validate semantically aligned work contexts, executable tasks, and evidence-grounded verifiers, adapting their actions to workspace state and execution feedback rather than following a fixed construction workflow. translated_title: WorkRover：通过递归环境演化扩展长时程协作智能体训练
translated_abstract: 扩展交互式环境对于通过强化学习训练长时程智能体至关重要。这些环境在初始生成之后通常需要进一步的测试与完善，而修正某个任务中的缺陷可能还需要同步更新其工作上下文和验证器。然而，现有的构建流水线在保持这些组件相互对齐的同时，对这种迭代式完善的支持十分有限。我们提出了 WorkRover，这是一个通过递归环境演化来训练长时程协作智能体的框架。其由执行框架驱动的合成方法使构建智能体能够联合构建并验证语义对齐的工作上下文、可执行任务以及基于证据的验证器，使构建智能体的行动能够适应工作区状态和执行反馈，而非遵循固定的构建流程。为了支持环境演化，我们引入了因子兼容性重放，它利用 rollout 反馈来……
tldr: WorkRover 提出了一个通过递归环境演化训练长时程协作智能体的框架，利用执行框架驱动的合成方法联合构建并验证语义对齐的工作上下文、可执行任务和基于证据的验证器，并引入因子兼容性重放利用 rollout 反馈来支持环境演化。
en_tdlr: WorkRover is a framework for training long-horizon cowork agents through recursive environment evolution, using harness-driven synthesis to jointly build and validate semantically aligned work contexts, executable tasks, and evidence-grounded verifiers, with Factorial Compatibility Replay leveraging rollout feedback to support environment evolution.
